verdicts.reason: A breaks the diamond mosaic: the photo is hard-cropped flat at the top, the white gutters are misaligned, and stray white triangles float under the grid. Its underline has also come away from the headline and now sits on top of the body copy, with a big gap above it. B keeps the mosaic and the headline, rule and body group intact, but it is basically a shrunk copy, with a flat-cut photo top, an empty white band above and below, and small body text.
